chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl narrated from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Sawrah ibn Kulayb, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a menstruating woman: should she wash the clothes that she wore during her menses? He said: She washes whatever of the blood has affected her clothes, and she leaves aside whatever is other than that. I said to him: Even though she has perspired in them? He said: Indeed, perspiration is not from menstruation.

key_terms.الدَّمِ: the menstrual blood that affects the clothing

ai.seo_question: Does a menstruating woman have to wash all the clothes she wore during her period?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the clothes worn by a menstruating woman. It states that only the places touched by menstrual blood must be washed, while mere perspiration does not render the clothing in need of washing on account of menstruation.
